attempts.code:
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
cands = grasp_candidates("green_pen")
# Select candidate grasping across the pen width (squeeze width close to footprint_short)
cand = min(cands, key=lambda c: c["squeeze_width"])
res = grasp(cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    # The green_pen is held horizontally across the gripper fingers (along the gripper's side vector).
    # To place it upright in the holder (cup), pitch the gripper 90 degrees so the pen aligns vertically,
    # or re-orient gripper approach horizontally so the pen axis becomes vertical.
    # Held across width: pen axis is along 'side' = approach x finger_axis.
    # If approach is horizontal (e.g. [1, 0, 0]) and finger_axis is horizontal (e.g. [0, 1, 0]),
    # side = [1, 0, 0] x [0, 1, 0] = [0, 0, 1] (vertical).
    hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
    rim_z = obs["table_z"] + holder["rim_height"]

    # First carry pen high above holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=holder["rim_height"] + 0.15)

    # Reorient gripper to make the pen vertical: approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0]
    # Check IK and move
    target_z = rim_z + 0.10
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="joint")

    # Lower slightly into the holder
    move_by(dz=-0.05)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
